recipes.name: 经典长袖女仆装
recipes.description: 黑白配色的传统长袖女仆裙，白围裙覆盖黑色长裙，端正而不暴露。
caption_en: The outfit is a modest black long-sleeved maid dress layered beneath a crisp white apron.
Restrained frills edge the dress, paired with black pantyhose and Mary Jane shoes.

recipes.name: 咖啡店女仆装
recipes.description: 轻快的咖啡店制服，短泡泡袖、及膝裙和腰间围裙，适合日常服务场景。
caption_en: The cafe uniform combines a black knee-length maid dress with short puffed sleeves and a fitted waist apron.
A small bow tie, frilled skirt edge, knee-high socks, and Mary Jane shoes complete the outfit.

recipes.name: 执事燕尾服
recipes.description: 偏中性的正式执事装，白衬衫、黑色燕尾服、长裤与白手套。
caption_en: A fitted black tailcoat and matching dress trousers are layered over a clean white formal shirt.
A neat bow tie, white gloves, and polished dress shoes finish the androgynous butler uniform.

recipes.name: 复古餐厅服务生
recipes.description: 复古餐厅风格的白衬衫、深色及膝裙和腰间围裙，搭配玛丽珍鞋。
caption_en: The vintage waitress uniform layers a practical waist apron over a dark knee-length skirt and short-sleeved white shirt.
A compact bow tie and simple Mary Jane shoes keep the outfit tidy and restrained.

recipes.name: 现代护士制服
recipes.description: 整洁克制的白色护士制服，短袖连衣裙、白色长袜与低跟鞋。
caption_en: The modern nurse uniform is a clean white short-sleeved dress with a modest straight silhouette.
Opaque white pantyhose and low white shoes complete the clinical outfit.

recipes.name: 双排扣厨师服
recipes.description: 白色双排扣厨师上衣、深色长裤与实用围裙，整体干净利落。
caption_en: A structured white double-breasted chef jacket is worn with a practical apron and straight black trousers.
Plain black work shoes complete the clean professional uniform.

recipes.name: 办公室套裙
recipes.description: 深色西装外套配白衬衫和铅笔裙，搭配连裤袜与低调高跟鞋。
caption_en: A dark tailored blazer is layered over a crisp white shirt and a fitted pencil skirt.
Sheer pantyhose and understated high heels complete the formal office ensemble.

recipes.name: 学院西装制服
recipes.description: 学院风西装制服，包含深色 blazer、白衬衫、领带和百褶裙。
caption_en: The school uniform layers a dark fitted blazer over a collared white shirt and a neatly tied necktie.
A pleated skirt, knee-high socks, and loafers form the lower half of the coordinated outfit.

recipes.name: 长袖水手服
recipes.description: 经典长袖水手服，水手领、领巾、百褶裙和及膝袜。
caption_en: The long-sleeved serafuku has a broad sailor collar and a neatly tied neckerchief above a pleated skirt.
Knee-high socks and simple loafers complete the classic school uniform.

recipes.name: 运动队服
recipes.description: 适合训练和日常活动的拉链运动外套、运动长裤与运动鞋。
caption_en: A zip-front track jacket and matching straight track pants form a coordinated athletic suit.
Supportive sneakers keep the practical training outfit suitable for everyday movement.

recipes.name: 宽松连帽衫
recipes.description: 宽松长款连帽衫配修身长裤和运动鞋，舒适而有现代感。
caption_en: An oversized long-sleeved hoodie falls loosely over fitted leggings for a relaxed layered silhouette.
Simple sneakers balance the roomy upper garment with a practical casual finish.

recipes.name: 针织开衫百褶裙
recipes.description: 柔和针织开衫叠穿翻领衬衫，配百褶裙、及膝袜和乐福鞋。
caption_en: A soft knitted cardigan is layered over a crisp collared shirt and a neatly pleated skirt.
Knee-high socks and classic loafers complete the gentle preppy combination.

recipes.name: 绞花毛衣长裙
recipes.description: 厚实绞花针织毛衣搭配素色长裙与短靴，温暖安静的秋冬搭配。
caption_en: A thick cable-knit sweater is paired with a plain long skirt for a warm, softly structured silhouette.
Opaque pantyhose and ankle boots complete the quiet autumn outfit.

recipes.name: 高领毛衣长裤
recipes.description: 简洁高领针织衫配高腰长裤和乐福鞋，强调成熟利落的轮廓。
caption_en: A clean turtleneck sweater is tucked into tailored high-waisted trousers and secured with a narrow belt.
Plain loafers finish the mature, streamlined outfit.

recipes.name: 牛仔夹克休闲装
recipes.description: 短款牛仔夹克叠穿白色上衣，下搭牛仔裤和运动鞋。
caption_en: A cropped denim jacket is layered over a plain white shirt and paired with straight jeans.
Casual sneakers complete the coordinated denim outfit without extra accessories.

recipes.name: 工装背带裤
recipes.description: 条纹长袖上衣搭配蓝色工装背带裤和帆布运动鞋。
caption_en: Blue work overalls are layered over a striped long-sleeved shirt with the bib and straps clearly visible.
Canvas-style sneakers complete the practical casual outfit.

recipes.name: 收腰衬衫裙
recipes.description: 有翻领和前排纽扣的长袖衬衫裙，以腰带收束轮廓，搭配短靴。
caption_en: The long-sleeved shirt dress has a crisp collar and a full row of front buttons.
A fitted belt defines the waist, while ankle boots give the restrained dress a structured finish.

recipes.name: 碎花夏日连衣裙
recipes.description: 轻盈的碎花夏日连衣裙，及膝裙摆与细带凉鞋，整体清爽自然。
caption_en: A light floral sundress falls to the knees with an airy, uncomplicated silhouette.
Delicate strapped sandals complete the fresh summer outfit.

recipes.name: 开衫长连衣裙
recipes.description: 长款素色连衣裙外搭轻薄开衫和浅口鞋，适合温和日常造型。
caption_en: A lightweight cardigan is layered over a plain full-length dress with a soft vertical drape.
Simple flats keep the gentle everyday outfit understated.

recipes.name: 长袖睡衣套装
recipes.description: 宽松的长袖纽扣睡衣上衣与睡裤，搭配室内拖鞋。
caption_en: The loose pajama set has a long-sleeved button-front top and matching relaxed pajama trousers.
Soft indoor slippers complete the comfortable sleepwear ensemble.

recipes.name: 经典风衣
recipes.description: 及膝双排扣风衣叠穿高领衫与格纹半裙，搭配短靴。
caption_en: A knee-length double-breasted trench coat is layered over a turtleneck and a plaid skirt.
Pantyhose and ankle boots complete the structured transitional outfit.

recipes.name: 牛角扣大衣
recipes.description: 学院感牛角扣大衣搭配围巾、百褶裙、厚袜和短靴。
caption_en: A collegiate duffel coat with visible toggle fastenings is layered over a pleated skirt.
A wrapped scarf, thick knee-high socks, and sturdy boots complete the winter outfit.

recipes.name: 短款羽绒服
recipes.description: 短款羽绒夹克叠穿毛衣，下搭牛仔裤和保暖雪地靴。
caption_en: A cropped quilted down jacket is layered over a warm sweater and straight jeans.
Gloves and insulated snow boots complete the practical cold-weather outfit.

recipes.name: 明黄色雨衣
recipes.description: 明黄色连帽雨衣搭配深色打底裤和橡胶雨靴。
caption_en: A bright yellow hooded raincoat forms a clean waterproof outer layer over dark leggings.
Rubber rain boots complete the simple wet-weather outfit.

recipes.name: 海军呢大衣
recipes.description: 深蓝色双排扣海军呢大衣配围巾、及膝裙和长靴。
caption_en: A dark navy double-breasted peacoat is layered over a knee-length skirt with a wrapped scarf at the collar.
Tall boots complete the compact maritime winter silhouette.

recipes.name: 黑色机能风
recipes.description: 黑色机能风层叠搭配，包含多口袋背心、工装长裤、手套和战斗靴。
caption_en: The black techwear outfit layers a multi-pocket utility vest over a fitted base and practical cargo trousers.
Fingerless gloves and combat boots reinforce the functional, modular silhouette.

recipes.name: 飞行夹克街头装
recipes.description: 宽松飞行夹克叠穿图案 T 恤，下搭工装裤和厚底运动鞋。
caption_en: An oversized bomber jacket is layered over a graphic T-shirt and loose cargo trousers.
Chunky sneakers complete the relaxed streetwear proportions.

recipes.name: 棒球夹克学院风
recipes.description: 双色棒球夹克叠穿连帽衫，搭配百褶裙和运动鞋。
caption_en: A two-tone letterman jacket is layered over a soft hoodie and paired with a pleated skirt.
Casual sneakers complete the sporty collegiate combination.

recipes.name: 格纹朋克装
recipes.description: 黑色皮夹克搭配红黑格纹裙、铆钉腰带和战斗靴。
caption_en: A black leather jacket is paired with a red-and-black plaid skirt and a visible studded belt.
Black pantyhose and heavy combat boots complete the restrained punk outfit.

recipes.name: 复古侦探装
recipes.description: 棕色风衣内搭马甲、衬衫和领带，配格纹长裤与牛津鞋。
caption_en: A brown trench coat is layered over a waistcoat, collared shirt, and neatly tied necktie.
Plaid trousers and polished Oxford shoes complete the vintage detective ensemble.

recipes.name: 古典洛丽塔
recipes.description: 端庄的古典洛丽塔连衣裙，长袖、高领、蕾丝镶边与及膝袜。
caption_en: The classical Lolita dress has a high collar, long sleeves, a structured frilled skirt, and restrained lace trim.
Knee-high socks and Mary Jane shoes complete the balanced formal silhouette.

recipes.name: 哥特洛丽塔
recipes.description: 黑色哥特洛丽塔长袖裙，以蕾丝、褶边和黑色连裤袜构成层次。
caption_en: The Gothic Lolita outfit centers on a black long-sleeved dress built from layered lace and controlled frills.
Opaque black pantyhose and Mary Jane shoes continue the dark coordinated palette.

recipes.name: 甜系洛丽塔
recipes.description: 粉白配色的甜系洛丽塔裙，泡泡短袖、荷叶边和蝴蝶结装饰。
caption_en: The sweet Lolita dress uses a pink-and-white palette with short puffed sleeves and a full frilled skirt.
A neat bow, knee-high socks, and Mary Jane shoes complete the cheerful coordinated outfit.

recipes.name: 维多利亚长裙
recipes.description: 高领长袖的维多利亚长裙，收束腰线并以蕾丝手套和短靴收尾。
caption_en: The Victorian long dress has a high collar, fitted waist, long sleeves, and a full ankle-length skirt.
Lace gloves and ankle boots complete the period-inspired formal silhouette.

recipes.name: 宝石蓝晚礼服
recipes.description: 宝石蓝及地晚礼服，露肩领口、长手套和同色高跟鞋，保持正式而克制。
caption_en: A jewel-blue floor-length evening gown falls from a restrained off-shoulder neckline in a clean formal silhouette.
Long elbow gloves and matching high heels complete the coordinated evening ensemble.

recipes.name: 酒红鸡尾酒裙
recipes.description: 酒红色及膝鸡尾酒裙，以细腰带和黑色高跟鞋完成简洁宴会造型。
caption_en: A wine-red knee-length cocktail dress has a clean fitted shape defined by a narrow waist belt.
Simple black high heels complete the restrained party outfit.

recipes.name: 白衬衫燕尾礼服
recipes.description: 黑色燕尾礼服搭配白衬衫、领结、修身长裤与白手套。
caption_en: A sharp black tailcoat and fitted dress trousers are layered over a crisp white formal shirt.
A bow tie, white gloves, and polished dress shoes complete the formal tuxedo ensemble.

recipes.name: 正式振袖和服
recipes.description: 层次完整的正式振袖和服，以宽腰带、足袋与草履组成传统搭配。
caption_en: The formal furisode kimono has long flowing sleeves and overlapping front layers secured by a broad structured obi.
White tabi socks and traditional zouri sandals complete the ceremonial outfit.

recipes.name: 夏日浴衣
recipes.description: 轻薄夏日浴衣，配宽腰带和木屐，图案保持简洁清爽。
caption_en: The lightweight summer yukata wraps cleanly across the body and is secured by a broad obi with a restrained floral pattern.
Traditional geta sandals complete the simple seasonal outfit.

recipes.name: 巫女装束
recipes.description: 白色小袖上衣、红色袴、足袋与草履组成的完整巫女装束。
caption_en: The shrine maiden outfit layers a white wide-sleeved kosode above full red hakama trousers.
White tabi socks and traditional zouri sandals complete the ceremonial combination.

recipes.name: 层叠汉服
recipes.description: 宽袖上衣、系带与长裙构成的层叠汉服，线条柔和流畅。
caption_en: The layered hanfu combines a wide-sleeved upper robe with overlapping panels and a long flowing skirt.
A broad sash secures the layers while preserving the soft vertical drape.

recipes.name: 端庄旗袍
recipes.description: 高领短袖的深色旗袍，保留传统盘扣和克制侧开衩，搭配低跟鞋。
caption_en: The dark qipao has a high collar, short sleeves, a fitted long line, and traditional knotted closures.
A restrained side slit and low block heels keep the formal dress modest and balanced.

recipes.name: 学院派女巫装
recipes.description: 深色长袖女巫裙、短披肩、尖顶帽和系带短靴，整体偏学院奇幻。
caption_en: A dark long-sleeved witch dress is layered beneath a short capelet with a compact pointed hat above.
Lace-up ankle boots complete the academic fantasy outfit.

recipes.name: 旅行法师袍
recipes.description: 便于行动的分层法师袍，带兜帽短斗篷、腰包、手套和长靴。
caption_en: A practical layered mage robe is covered by a short hooded cape and secured at the waist with a belt pouch.
Gloves and sturdy boots complete the travel-ready fantasy outfit.

recipes.name: 轻甲弓手装
recipes.description: 皮革轻甲叠穿短上衣，配护臂、肩甲、长靴和箭袋。
caption_en: Light leather armor is layered over a fitted tunic with shoulder guards and protective forearm bracers.
Thigh-high boots and a visible quiver complete the mobile archer outfit.

recipes.name: 银色骑士甲
recipes.description: 完整但不过度笨重的银色板甲，包含护手、胫甲、铁靴与披风。
caption_en: Fitted silver plate armor forms a complete but mobile armored dress with articulated gauntlets and greaves.
Metal sabatons and a plain cape complete the balanced knight ensemble.

recipes.name: 轻装冒险者
recipes.description: 实用的旅行短上衣、皮背心、腰带、打底裤和及膝靴。
caption_en: A practical travel tunic is layered beneath a fitted leather vest and secured with a utility belt.
Leggings, fingerless gloves, and knee-high boots complete the lightweight adventurer outfit.

recipes.name: 蒸汽朋克旅行装
recipes.description: 维多利亚式衬衫叠穿棕色马甲和长裙，以齿轮饰件、手套和系带靴点缀。
caption_en: A Victorian-style blouse is layered beneath a brown waistcoat and paired with a full long skirt.
Small gear ornaments, gloves, lace-up boots, and practical goggles complete the steampunk travel outfit.

recipes.name: 蓝白偶像舞台装
recipes.description: 蓝白配色的偶像舞台服，泡泡袖、荷叶短裙、蝴蝶结和短靴构成清晰轮廓。
caption_en: The blue-and-white idol costume combines puffed sleeves with a layered frilled skirt and a prominent coordinated bow.
Thigh-high socks and ankle boots complete the crisp stage silhouette.

recipes.name: 古典芭蕾舞裙
recipes.description: 端庄的古典芭蕾造型，硬纱短裙、连体舞衣、浅色连裤袜和芭蕾舞鞋。
caption_en: A fitted ballet leotard supports a structured classical tutu with clean, even layers.
Light opaque pantyhose and ballet slippers complete the restrained dance costume.
